request.description: Whether to launch a new process or attach to a running one.

program.description: Path to the program to launch: a .NET Framework .exe, a .NET .dll, or an apphost executable.

project.description: Instead of program: a project file or directory whose output (MSBuild TargetPath) is launched. Legacy projects are resolved with MSBuild.exe.

build.description: Build the project before launching it.

framework.description: Target framework to debug when project targets several, such as net48.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

env.description: Environment variables for the program; null removes a variable.

console.description: Where the program's console goes. Only the terminals give it standard input.

launchSettingsProfile.description: launchSettings.json profile to apply with project; an empty string applies none.

stopAtEntry.description: Stop at the program's entry point.

justMyCode.description: Only step through and break in user code. False also disables the framework's NGen images, so that its code can be stepped into.

allowImplicitFuncEval.description: Run the program's code (ToString, property getters, DebuggerDisplay) to show values.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps source paths in the symbols to local directories.

symbolOptions.description: Where to look for symbols that are not next to their modules.

processId.description: Process ID to attach to. The process must be 64-bit and have the .NET runtime loaded.
